jspace_zoom_chamber.name: J-Space Zoom Chamber (the hidden layer, walkable)
jspace_zoom_chamber.description: Seventeen feature-words from the count-to-five interpretability image, each a pillar standing at its REAL coordinate in the book's own LSA space (MDS of cosine distances; Kruskal stress-1 posted on the center plaque). Walking distance is semantic distance, up to the reported stress. Activation = pillar height and glow, from real document frequency. Introspective pillars (thoughts, claude, human, fascinating) light only under gaze — the observer effect as floor. OOV words (consciousness, mississippi, chat, countdown, okay) stand dark on the rim: the book has never said them, so it cannot place them. After Anthropic's feature-activation visualizations.

jspace_feature_field.name: J-Space Feature Field (sparse, breathing)
jspace_feature_field.description: The raw activation field before the zoom: a seeded sparse grid where most tiles stay dark (sparsity as the honest majority), some glow blue, dense cells stack as height (superposition), and tiles brighten near the walker — attention as proximity.

jspace_count_plates.name: J-Space Count Plates (the output, walked)
jspace_count_plates.description: Five coral floor plates, one to five, stepped strictly in order; wrong order flashes red and resets; the fifth emits exam_passed so the ExamGate completes the map. The output strip of the interpretability image made performable — the body does autoregression, one token per stride.

jspace_ring.name: J-Space Ring (the endless topic scroller)
jspace_ring.description: The spine's whole arc as a ring you walk forever: 24 topic arcs (point, line, grid, array, loop, random, walk, noise, wave, sound, fractal, recursion, grammar, branch, growth, cell, neighbor, spring, cloth, force, agent, flock, learn, proof) with 60 concept-words standing as pillars at the angle of their peak topic. Your angular position IS the reading axis — walk the loop and every pillar's height and glow interpolates continuously between the two topics you stand between, measured as LSA activation in the book's own corpus. Point-country sinks behind you as line-country rises ahead; walk long enough and point comes back around after proof. The endless twin of the count-to-five chamber.
